title: Register a member
goal: A librarian registers a new member so that the member can borrow tools.

title: Add a tool
goal: A librarian adds a donated or bought tool to the catalog.

title: Borrow a tool
goal: A member borrows an available tool for the loan period.
notes: When a check fails, the library says which one, in this order: unknown member, unknown tool, member has an overdue loan, member is at the loan limit, tool needs repair, tool is on loan.

title: Return a tool
goal: A member brings a tool back; the librarian checks it and records the return.

title: Report damage
goal: A librarian takes a tool out of lending when it is found damaged outside a return (for example on the shelf, or reported by a borrower by phone), with a note saying what is wrong.

title: Mark a tool repaired
goal: Once a damaged tool is fixed, a librarian marks it repaired, which puts it back in good condition, clears its damage note and makes it available to borrow again.

title: See the tools waiting for repair
goal: A librarian sees every tool that needs repair, the one waiting longest first, with what is wrong with it and since when, to choose what to fix next.

title: Renew a loan
goal: A member who needs a tool longer keeps it for another loan period, before the loan is due.
